Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL1054501. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical_smiles, and join assays on assay_id to filter by chembl_id. Filter where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
